title: 2026 Honda Civic Hybrid Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: One year on from a considerable refresh, the 2026 Honda Civic Hybrid is essentially a carryover model in sedan and hatchback body styles, pairing 200 horsepower with 50-mpg efficiency.
body_markdown:
The Honda Civic Hybrid returned to North America for the 2025 model year and is part of the 11th-generation Civic lineup, introduced in 2022. It sits in the compact car class, and the hybrid version competes against the Toyota Prius, the Toyota Corolla Hybrid, and the Hyundai Elantra Hybrid. The 2026 Honda Civic Hybrid has two trims: Sport Hybrid and Sport Touring Hybrid.

## What’s New for the 2026 Honda Civic Hybrid


The entire Honda Civic lineup got a massive refresh in 2025, which included exterior design tweaks, updated interior trim, and new tech features such as Google built-in, as well as the inclusion of the hybrid powertrain in the lineup. Therefore, the 2026 Civic Hybrid is a carryover model with no significant changes.


## Design


The Honda Civic Hybrid is available in both sedan and hatchback body styles, though the hatch looks remarkably like a sedan from the side. The 2025 refresh adds a more aggressive front fascia and the overall design is handsome. There are no appearance packages available on the hybrid, but there are a few 18-inch wheel options with silver or black finishes, depending on the trim level. While there are several free color options, premium paint colors cost $455 on both the sedan and the hatchback.


## Powertrain


The front-wheel-drive-only Civic Hybrid is equipped with a 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine, which is paired with Honda’s two-motor hybrid system. Total system output is 200 horsepower and 232 pound-feet of torque. The EPA estimates the sedan will get 50 mpg in the city and 47 mpg on the highway, while the hatchback should return 50 mpg and 45 mpg, respectively.


## Interior


Both the sedan and hatchback versions of the Civic Hybrid seat five passengers, but the latter has significantly more cargo space. The hatchback has a 24.5-cubic-foot cargo area and the sedan's is 14.8 cubic feet. The hybrid is among the more premium models in the Civic lineup and comes standard with heated front seats, a one-touch power moonroof, dual-zone automatic climate control, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, and 60/40 split fold rear seats. Leather seats and power front seats are available.


## Technology


The 2026 Honda Civic Hybrid has a solid list of standard tech features, including wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Wi-Fi hotspot capability (subscription required), multiple USB-C charging ports, over-the-air updates, and a 9-inch infotainment screen. Upgrading to the Sport Touring trim adds a wireless phone charger, a 10.2-inch digital cluster, and standard Google built-in with things like Google Maps and Google Assistant. While an 8-speaker audio system is standard on the Sport Hybrid, the Sport Touring Hybrid gets the 12-speaker Bose premium audio system.

## Safety


The Honda Civic Hybrid has an impressive list of standard safety features for a compact car, including automatic emergency braking, lane-departure warning, a rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines, adaptive cruise control, lane-keep assist, traffic-sign recognition, blind-spot monitors, and rear cross-traffic alert. Available features include parking sensors and low-speed braking control. The Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) doesn’t provide specific testing for hybrid models, but it awarded the 2026 Civic hatchback and sedan Top Safety Pick designations. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) gives both the hatchback and sedan Hybrid models an overall five-out-of-five-star safety rating.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2026 Honda Civic Hybrid went on sale in mid-2025. At the time of writing, the Civic Sport Hybrid sedan started at $30,590 and the Sport Touring Hybrid at $33,590. The hatchback models start at $31,790, with the Sport Hybrid and Sport Touring Hybrid at $34,790. These trims are mostly without packages or options, but there are several accessories, such as roof baskets, protective films, and kayak attachments, priced from $25 to $412.
